Chapter 1127: 42: Departure (End Of This Volume, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1127: Chapter 42: Departure (End of this volume, please subscribe)

“Conceded?”

Lin Yuan immediately retracted his Fierce Sun Divine Body, and the vast, blistering Fierce Sun world rapidly dissipated.

“Galaxy, with your strength, you’d likely rival those Heavenly Venerates.”

King Chibao couldn’t help but say.

For a core royal who has grown to their limit, at most, they can contend a few moves with a Heavenly Venerate by relying solely on themselves.

As for full-blown combat? They certainly can’t defeat a Heavenly Venerate.

But at this moment, the feeling King Chibao had about Lin Yuan was in no way inferior to those Heavenly Venerates.

Although Lin Yuan had not exerted his full strength, and both sides only collided in the world of the Fierce Sun.

In an actual fight, there are still too many variables, as the strongest part of the Heavenly Venerates is not their Fierce Sun Divine Body.

But King Chibao still had such a feeling.

“I don’t think I am a match for a Heavenly Venerate yet.”

Lin Yuan said.

“Even if not, there’s not much difference.”

King Chibao said, with a tone of certainty.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan did not deny it.

It was indeed so.

Right now, Lin Yuan’s strength was already very close to that of a true Heavenly Venerate.

Actually, to say that he could compare to them was entirely accurate, as Lin Yuan could completely contend with some newly ascended Heavenly Venerates.

“When I complete the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’, and undergo a significant transformation of my internal universe, I can truly contend with the Heavenly Venerates and the Chaos Great Saints.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Originally, the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’ was only to make Lin Yuan’s internal universe achieve a size approaching that of the Chaos Great Saints.

In terms of strength, he naturally was not yet the true opponent of a Chaos Great Saint.

But the fusion and devouring of the Fierce Sun source within his internal universe resulted in an unexpected evolutionary enhancement.

Causing him to possess the internal universe of a Great Saint level even before completing the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’.

It’s predictable, if the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’ is completed, Lin Yuan’s internal universe may surpass that of a normal Chaos Great Saint’s internal universe.

By then, even if there are shortcomings in other areas, on average, he would still possess genuine Great Saint-level combat power.

“Hahahahaha, good, good, good!”

King Chibao was delighted; the stronger Lin Yuan was, the happier he became, for it meant that the future foundation of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s royal lineage would be more solid.

In the future, even if Lin Yuan doesn’t break the shackles of the Heavenly Venerate, with his current strength, the royal family would still be confident when facing those Heavenly Venerates.

“Galaxy, when will you accompany me to the capital?”

King Chibao asked.

He was eager to bring Lin Yuan back.

“Wait a little longer.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and said.

Based on the current speed of his bloodline’s transformation and tempering, it would take a few more months before it reaches the concentration close to that of a core royal bloodline.

By then, Lin Yuan could proceed to the capital without concern.

“Alright.”

King Chibao nodded.

He didn’t ask much about why they needed to wait, as it was Lin Yuan’s concern.

…

“This fluctuation of space and time?”

Below, King Chisong and King Chijue were receiving several young men and women.

These young men and women had come along with King Chibao, aiming to support the war efforts here. King Chibao was a pinnacle core royal, as was King Lingshen.

The peak combat strength of both sides was about the same; at this time, having an additional Great Lord was very important, not to mention that these young men and women belonged to the royal Great Lords, with combat ability akin to ordinary peak Great Lords.

“Is King Chibao sparring with Senior Galaxy?”

King Chijue’s pupils narrowed slightly, and the expressions of the others also changed.

King Chibao was acknowledged as a pinnacle core royal, as was Galaxy, whose strength was confirmed by defeating King Lingshen.

These two were sparring?

“King Chibao…”

Several young men and women exchanged looks. Since they had followed King Chibao here, they evidently belonged to the same royal branch and naturally hoped King Chibao would win.

The royal lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was similarly divided into many branches, with those having a pinnacle core royal as their pillar considered to be powerful.

However.

Soon.

The expressions of these young men and women changed.

“Did King Chibao lose?”

Although they couldn’t sense specifics, they could feel the collision of those two extremely fiery auras, with the one belonging to King Chibao clearly at a disadvantage, and eventually, both fiery auras quickly dissipated.

Clearly, the sparring had ended.

“Senior Galaxy is too strong.”

King Chisong couldn’t help but feel; when Lin Yuan defeated King Lingshen earlier, perhaps it was due to the latter having only recently reached his peak.

But King Chibao? He was a veteran pinnacle core royal.

Beside him, King Chijue also showed astonishment in his expression. He could see that Lin Yuan and King Chibao were merely sparring lightly, yet the latter conceded so quickly, indicating just how powerful Lin Yuan truly was.

“Chisong, you’re incredibly lucky.”

King Chijue glanced at King Chisong and said.

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan, the two of them wouldn’t be sitting here leisurely chatting.

“Indeed.”

King Chisong nodded.

…

Time slowly passed.

In the blink of an eye, several months had gone by.

Qingfen City was bustling with people, prosperity unchanged.

At this moment, the topic about Great Lord Galaxy in Qingfen City was definitely the most frequent; several months ago, the battle between two domains occurred, Great Lord Galaxy made a move, slaying the King Lingshen, reversed the situation, and saved Qingfen Domain and dozens of neighboring domains.

“Everyone, I know more intelligence related to that war.” Inside a plain tavern, a group of eleventh-order beings gathered, among them a dark-skinned man spoke.

“Let’s hear it.”

The other eleventh-order beings were interested; they weren’t even in the Self-Dao Realm, so they didn’t know much about the two-domain battle, only understanding that Great Lord Galaxy played a pivotal role, almost sweeping the entire battlefield single-handedly.

Yu Chaolong was also among them.

Having set off from the Yu Family several months ago, he only arrived in Qingfen City today.

Over the months, more and more information reached the Yu Family; the feats of Lin Yuan were almost confirmed, and even on his journey, Yu Chaolong heard a lot of rumors regarding Great Lord Galaxy.

“Do you know how Great Lord Galaxy killed that King Lingshen?” The dark-skinned man said proudly.

“King Lingshen is an ultimate core royal clan, his strength invincible among Great Lords, even if Great Lord Galaxy could kill him, it would be after a hard battle?”

An eleventh-order being speculated.

That’s the most logical assumption.

Actually, if it weren’t for various rumors stating Great Lord Galaxy killed King Lingshen, the eleventh-order beings present would believe King Lingshen merely fled, not died.

Killing an ultimate core royal clan, is it that easy?

“Wrong, wrong, wrong.” The dark-skinned man shook his head, “Great Lord Galaxy killed that King Lingshen with hardly any effort, it was over in a few moves.”

Upon hearing this.

All other eleventh-order beings looked at each other in disbelief.

Killed King Lingshen?

A few moves?

“Really?”

“That’s an ultimate core royal clan?”

“Could it be Great Lord Galaxy has stepped into Heavenly Venerate?”

Many eleventh-order beings spoke up.

“Heh, I don’t know about that, but I’m sure Great Lord Galaxy is definitely not Heavenly Venerate.” The dark-skinned man said, “If Heavenly Venerate made a move, the Da Ling Ancient Country over there wouldn’t have done nothing.”

War between Ancient Countries, if it’s only a localized conflict, the involvement of Heavenly Venerate-level experts is prohibited, that’s an unwritten rule.

Because if one side deploys a Heavenly Venerate, the other side would certainly dispatch a Heavenly Venerate too.

But now the Da Ling Ancient Country is silent, evidently Great Lord Galaxy is not Heavenly Venerate.

“Don’t believe it?” The dark-skinned man glanced around and continued, “You’ve all heard about how Great Lord Galaxy captured all Great Lords from the Da Ling Ancient Country, right?”

“If the King Lingshen battled fiercely against Great Lord Galaxy, these Great Lords from Da Ling Ancient Country would have surely fled back by now.”

The dark-skinned man said.

“Indeed.”

“If King Lingshen didn’t perish swiftly, those Great Lords from Da Ling Ancient Country would surely have reacted.”

Many eleventh-order beings pondered and found the dark-skinned man’s words quite reasonable; Great Lord Galaxy killed King Lingshen likely without spending much time, the battle must have been a one-sided crush.

Otherwise, on Da Ling Ancient Country’s side, not a single Great Lord would have escaped, all becoming captives of Great Lord Galaxy.

“Great Lord Galaxy…”

In the corner of the tavern, Yu Chaolong quietly listened; he had heard such discussions too many times along the way, the shock in his heart had never subsided.

…

Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, the fierce sun source within his body universe constantly radiating fierce sunlight, resonating with the eternal fierce sun outside, consequently drawing strands of mysterious fiery aura into him.

Under the diffusion of these strands of fiery aura, the fierce sun bloodline flowing within Lin Yuan quickly became rich and pure.

“Already reached the threshold of core royal family bloodline.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.

Indeed, within Fierce Sun Ancient Country, there exist methods for purifying fierce sun bloodline, but none of them is anything less than extremely challenging, like becoming a king?

Lin Yuan’s capability to effortlessly purify and refine his bloodline is absolutely inconceivable.

In fact, Lin Yuan’s method of purifying and refining fierce sun bloodline, although seemingly simple, is tougher than becoming a king of an ancient country.

First, one must awaken the ‘Fierce Sun Opening Heaven’ Divine Skills, an ability derived from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, which probably even a king doesn’t have.

Secondly, possessing a «Infinite Void» internal universe is even more daunting.

These two conditions, each alone are tougher than becoming an ancient country king, both combined? Only Lin Yuan could achieve this.

“Time to leave.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan appeared outside Sky Burning Court.

Simultaneously, he created an avatar, stationed in Sky Burning Court.

Because the Da Ling Ancient Country will exchange ransoms for the captured Great Lords soon, Lin Yuan needs to leave an avatar here.

Additionally, this avatar can handle numerous other mundane matters.

Before the Space-Time Teleportation Formation in Qingfen City.

King Chibao had long been waiting, upon seeing Lin Yuan appear, he smiled and said, “Galaxy, is everything ready?”

“Ready.”

Lin Yuan nodded and said.

“Then let’s head to the royal capital, it’s far more prosperous than this domain.”

King Chibao smiled, “Only in the royal capital can your potential, Galaxy, truly be unleashed.”

“Let’s go.”

King Chibao immediately activated the Space-Time Teleportation Formation, connecting to the distant royal capital, and promptly stepped into it.

Lin Yuan glanced at the Space-Time Teleportation Formation, hesitated not, and similarly stepped inside.
